title: Better Beta Controls
description: Brings modern control customization to Minecraft Beta 1.7.3
body:
Brings modern control customization to Minecraft Beta 1.7.3. Every key, fully rebindable.

## Features

- **Hotbar 1–9** fully rebindable — no longer hardcoded to number keys
- **F1 / F2 / F3 / F5 / F11** rebindable — Hide HUD, Screenshot, Debug Info, Third Person, Fullscreen
- **Separate Dismount key** — leave boats and minecarts without conflicting with other binds
- **Mouse Release key** — free your cursor from the window without closing the game
- **Pause on Focus Loss** toggle — prevent the game from pausing when you alt-tab
- **Conflict detection** — duplicate bindings are highlighted in red in the controls screen
- **Reset Defaults** button — restore all keybindings to vanilla values in one click
- Scrollable controls screen with mousewheel support — all binds visible and accessible

## Installation

### MultiMC / Prism Launcher
1. Right-click your Beta 1.7.3 instance and select **Edit Instance**
2. Go to the **jar mods** tab
3. Click **Add to Minecraft.jar** and select the downloaded `.zip`
4. Launch the game

### Manual
1. Locate your `minecraft.jar` (`.minecraft/bin/minecraft.jar`)
2. Open it with any archive tool (e.g. 7-Zip or WinRAR)
3. Delete the **META-INF** folder inside the jar
4. Drag and drop the mod files into the jar
5. Save and launch the game
